alpha1.0.0.description:
### SULFUR .apworld installation instructions

With Archipelago Launcher installed, simply double click the .apworld file after download.
Alternatively, move the .apworld file manually to the `custom_worlds` directory inside the Archipelago app directory `C:\ProgramData\Archipelago\custom_worlds`

#### SULFUR .yaml settings

Nothing does anything except the basic Archipelago settings like slot name, priority locations, progression value and such.

### SULFUR plugin installation instructions

- Download and install [BepInEx 5.4.23.5](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/tag/v5.4.23.5) or newer. (Simply unzip all files into the SULFUR directory, typically found at: `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\SULFUR`)
- Download and install the SULFUR Archipelago Plugin from this page and install by unzipping into the SULFUR directory.

The SULFUR directory should now have a BepInEx directory.

- Go to `SULFUR/BepInEx/config/` and edit `dk.nuzzles.archipelago.cfg` to point at your multiworld room. The game will automatically connect when you start a new save or load a save. You can optionally press F1 while in-game to edit the settings on the fly. STREAMER NOTE: If you press F1 your password and all connection details WILL be displayed, only do this if you are sure SULFUR is not currently being broadcast.

### Bonus info

While in The Church are and receiving a shortcut unlock or The Church Grounds unlock, you must leave and come back. This can be done by exiting to main menu and reloading the save.

If the Church collection box has been looted, and new items or Sulf is added to it by the multiworld, you must leave and come back. This can be done by exiting to main menu and reloading the save.
alpha1.0.0.title: SULFUR Archipelago alpha 1

alpha2.0.0.description:
### OBS
Alpha 2 is completely incompatible with Alpha 1, you cannot re-use the BepInEx plugin from the previous version, continue on a previously generated world, or otherwise combine the two.

### SULFUR .apworld installation instructions

With Archipelago Launcher installed, simply double click the .apworld file after download.
Alternatively, move the .apworld file manually to the `custom_worlds` directory inside the Archipelago app directory `C:\ProgramData\Archipelago\custom_worlds`

#### SULFUR .yaml settings

Nothing does anything except the basic Archipelago settings like slot name, priority locations, progression value and such.

### SULFUR plugin installation instructions
- Download and install [BepInEx 5.4.23.5](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/tag/v5.4.23.5) or newer. (Simply unzip all files into the SULFUR directory, typically found at: `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\SULFUR`)
- Download and install the SULFUR Archipelago Plugin from this page and install by unzipping into the SULFUR directory. (The SULFUR directory should now contain a BepInEx directory. Verify the installation by checking `BepInEx\plugins` and see if it contains Archipelago and SULFURNativeUILib)
- You can adjust connection details in the in-game options menu using the Archipelago sub-menu

### Bonus info / Weird stuff

Do not exit to main menu and load the save again, you must fully exit the game currently to make sure the state does not get.. Weird, or the game crashes. I apologise for the inconvenience and I'm working on it <3

While in The Church are and receiving a shortcut unlock or The Church Grounds unlock, you must leave and come back. This is most easily done by entering a level and returning. If you do not wish to enter a level, it is recommended that you completely close the game and start it again.
alpha2.0.0.title: SULFUR Archipelago Alpha 2
